usageNotes: Use this endpoint to run multiple PVE API commands against a single node in one round-trip, guaranteed in order. Access is restricted to the root@pam user — API tokens scoped to other users will be rejected regardless of privileges. The response is a synchronous array of per-command results (not a UPID), so all commands must complete before the response returns; avoid long-running commands in a batch.

examples.summary: Query node version and cluster status in a single batch call

tips: The commands value must be a JSON-encoded string (i.e., a string whose content is a JSON array), not a raw JSON array — double-encode it when constructing requests programmatically.
Commands execute sequentially; a failure in one command does not abort subsequent commands — check each result object individually for errors.
Only root@pam can call this endpoint; API token auth is allowed only when the token belongs to root@pam.
Prefer individual API calls for single operations; this batch endpoint is most useful for reducing latency when several read queries are needed together.
